about: Which printers only3d supports and how far each is tested. docs/printers.md is generated from this file (tools/printers_table.py); the app reads it to warn before a first print on a printer nobody has printed on with only3d. To report a print, open an issue with the printer, firmware and what came out.

statuses.tested: done on the real printer with only3d, and it came out right
statuses.checked: compared with the maker's own slicer (start and end G-code, settings) but not run on the printer
statuses.untested: should work, but nobody has checked it yet
